correctness.rationale: Pair weight four has the exact contiguous weight-three xor-zero characterization. GL(4,2) free orbit division is 20,160 with 210 equal ordered-pair choices, giving coefficient divisor 96. An exhaustive state recurrence counts every possible 13-symbol tail and the two wraparound triples exactly once; the seven coefficients sum to 13! and yield 64,864,800 indexed codes. Two standalone programs with different recursion/forward tabulation agree, while witnesses and two analytical factorial moments provide additional checks. No infinite claim is inferred from a finite experiment.

value.rationale: The second nontrivial binary Hamming block length (15) provides a natural finite geometry instance with 35 weight-three dependencies. Its complete local pair-weight-four multiplicity distribution directly measures susceptibility of all indexed Hamming layouts to the cyclic pair channel; the 17,106,784 optimal-indexed subset and sharp six-block maximum give exact design-space and extremal information beyond existence or a single example. This is a motivated complete finite census, not an arbitrary numeric slice or generic incremental row.
